shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile, low relief
shallow curved incised line/band across the stone
schematic animal with articulated legs and paws
unpolished tan stone surface in an excavated, rubble setting
justification: Both are rectangular stone pillars bearing shallow, flattened low-relief animals in strict profile with schematic legs and paws, and both carry a long shallow curved line sweeping across the lower part of the shaft, which suggests a common carving technique and stone. The decisive difference is density and organisation: A shows a single isolated creature on a largely blank field, while B is packed with stacked registers, a zigzag band, multiple birds, quadrupeds and small objects, so the compositional schemes barely correspond.
